test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. And that something in her lifted her to the world's number one position in tennis in 2005.

B. But all this happened in almost no time.

C. It took Maria just four years as a professional to reach the pinnacle.

D. There is something disarming about Maria Sharapova.
solution:
The correct answer is 'DABC.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "**Maria Sharapova**". Hence, 'D' is the first part.
 
• Sentence A will come after D as it is giving information about the disarming quality of Maria Sharapova that lifted her to world number one.
 
• Sentence B will come after A as it is giving information about the duration in which she became number one i.e. in** ****a very short period of time**.
 
• The sentence 'C' is the concluding part as it says how many years or time it took Maria to reach the peak i.e. four years.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *There is something disarming about Maria Sharapova. And that something in her lifted her to the world's number one position in tennis in 2005. But all this happened in almost no time. It took Maria just four years as a professional to reach the pinnacle*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
